title: Home Purchase Financing ACH Autopay Authorization Terms
content:
**Automatic ACH payment — terms for Home Purchase Financing borrowers**

- Enrolling in or cancelling autopay is the borrower's own authorization of ACH debits and is recorded only on the borrower's instruction.
- Autopay may be changed only on a loan that is active or delinquent, as the company's record of that loan shows.
- Autopay drafts the full installment on each due date.
- The program's autopay rate reduction is granted only when autopay is elected at closing; enrolling later never lowers the note rate, and cancelling later never raises it.

### Questions these terms answer

**May a borrower on a paid-off loan enroll?** No; autopay may be changed only on an active or delinquent loan.

**Does enrolling two years after closing lower the rate?** No; the reduction is granted only when autopay is elected at closing.

**Does cancelling autopay raise a rate that was reduced at closing?** No; cancelling later never raises it.

**How much does autopay draft?** The full installment, on each due date.
